   752→    def _parse_llm_response(self, text: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
   753→        """Parse structured JSON from LLM response."""
   754→        # Try to extract JSON from markdown code blocks
   755→        if "```" in text:
   756→            parts = text.split("```")
   757→            for part in parts:
   758→                part = part.strip()
   759→                if part.startswith("json"):
   760→                    part = part[4:].strip()
   761→                try:
   762→                    return json.loads(part)
   763→                except (json.JSONDecodeError, ValueError):
   764→                    continue
   765→
   766→        # Try direct JSON parse
   767→        try:
   768→            return json.loads(text)
   769→        except (json.JSONDecodeError, ValueError):
   770→            pass
   771→
   772→        # Fallback: treat as plain text answer
   773→        return {"action": "answer", "answer": text, "confidence": 0.6}

   786→    def _hash_context(self, context: Dict) -> str:
   787→        """Hash context dict for cache keying.
   788→
   789→        Uses xxhash (~100x faster than SHA-256) when available.
   790→        """
   791→        if not context:
   792→            return ""
   793→        try:
   794→            import orjson
   795→            raw = orjson.dumps(context, option=orjson.OPT_SORT_KEYS, default=str)
   796→        except (ImportError, TypeError):
   797→            raw = json.dumps(context, sort_keys=True, default=str).encode()
   798→        try:
   799→            import xxhash
   800→            return xxhash.xxh64(raw).hexdigest()[:16]
   801→        except ImportError:
   802→            return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()[:16]

    96→    def _compute_hash(self) -> str:

   167→class AuditLog:
   168→    """
   169→    Thread-safe audit log with hash chain integrity.
   170→
   171→    Usage:
   172→        log = AuditLog.get_instance()
   173→        log.log_action("create_light", "Created key light", category=AuditCategory.LIGHTING)
   174→    """
   175→
   176→    _instance: Optional['AuditLog'] = None
   177→    _lock = threading.Lock()
   178→
   179→    def __init__(self, log_dir: Optional[Path] = None):
   180→        self._entries: List[AuditEntry] = []
   181→        self._log_dir = log_dir or Path.home() / ".synapse" / "audit"
   182→        self._log_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
   183→        self._current_session = deterministic_uuid(f"session:{id(self)}:{threading.current_thread().ident}", "session")
   184→        self._last_hash = "genesis"
   185→        self._write_lock = threading.Lock()
   186→
   187→        # Callbacks for real-time monitoring
   188→        self._callbacks: List[Callable[[AuditEntry], None]] = []
   189→
   190→    @classmethod
   191→    def get_instance(cls, log_dir: Optional[Path] = None) -> 'AuditLog':
   192→        """Get singleton instance"""
   193→        with cls._lock:
   194→            if cls._instance is None:
   195→                cls._instance = cls(log_dir)
   196→            return cls._instance
   197→
   198→    @classmethod
   199→    def reset_instance(cls) -> None:
   200→        """Reset singleton (for testing)"""
   201→        with cls._lock:
   202→            cls._instance = None
   203→
   204→    def add_callback(self, callback: Callable[[AuditEntry], None]) -> None:
   205→        """Add callback for real-time log monitoring"""
   206→        self._callbacks.append(callback)
   207→
   208→    def remove_callback(self, callback: Callable[[AuditEntry], None]) -> None:
   209→        """Remove callback"""
   210→        if callback in self._callbacks:
   211→            self._callbacks.remove(callback)
   212→
   213→    def log(
   214→        self,
   215→        operation: str,
   216→        message: str,
   217→        level: AuditLevel = AuditLevel.INFO,
   218→        category: AuditCategory = AuditCategory.SYSTEM,
   219→        tool: str = "",
   220→        agent_id: str = "",
   221→        user_id: str = "",
   222→        operation_id: str = "",
   223→        input_data: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
   224→        output_data: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
   225→        sequence_id: str = "",
   226→    ) -> AuditEntry:
   227→        """
   228→        Log an audit entry.
   229→
   230→        Args:
   231→            operation: Name of operation (e.g., "create_light_group")
   232→            message: Human-readable description
   233→            level: Severity level
   234→            category: Category for filtering
   235→            tool: Tool name (e.g., "synapse", "engram")
   236→            agent_id: ID of AI agent (if applicable)
   237→            operation_id: Unique operation ID for correlation
   238→            input_data: Input parameters
   239→            output_data: Output/result data
   240→            sequence_id: Shot/sequence identifier
   241→
   242→        Returns:
   243→            Created AuditEntry
   244→        """
   245→        with self._write_lock:
   246→            entry = AuditEntry(
   247→                timestamp_utc=time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", time.gmtime()),
   248→                level=level,
   249→                category=category,
   250→                operation=operation,
   251→                message=message,
   252→                tool=tool,
   253→                agent_id=agent_id,
   254→                user_id=user_id,
   255→                session_id=self._current_session,
   256→                sequence_id=sequence_id,
   257→                operation_id=operation_id or deterministic_uuid(f"{operation}:{message}"),
   258→                input_data=input_data or {},
   259→                output_data=output_data or {},
   260→                previous_hash=self._last_hash,
   261→            )
   262→
   263→            self._entries.append(entry)
   264→            self._last_hash = entry.entry_hash
   265→
   266→            # Write to disk
   267→            self._persist_entry(entry)
   268→
   269→            # Notify callbacks
   270→            for callback in self._callbacks:
   271→                try:
   272→                    callback(entry)
   273→                except Exception:
   274→                    pass  # Don't let callback errors break logging
   275→
   276→            return entry
   277→
   278→    def log_agent_action(
   279→        self,
   280→        operation: str,
   281→        message: str,
   282→        agent_id: str,
   283→        category: AuditCategory,
   284→        **kwargs
   285→    ) -> AuditEntry:
   286→        """Convenience method for agent actions"""
   287→        return self.log(
   288→            operation=operation,
   289→            message=message,
   290→            level=AuditLevel.AGENT_ACTION,
   291→            category=category,
   292→            agent_id=agent_id,
   293→            **kwargs

   296→    def log_human_decision(
   297→        self,
   298→        operation: str,
   299→        message: str,
   300→        user_id: str,
   301→        category: AuditCategory,
   302→        **kwargs
   303→    ) -> AuditEntry:
   304→        """Convenience method for human decisions"""
   305→        entry = self.log(
   306→            operation=operation,
   307→            message=message,
   308→            level=AuditLevel.HUMAN_DECISION,
   309→            category=category,
   310→            **kwargs
   311→        )
   312→        entry.user_id = user_id
   313→        return entry
   314→
   315→    def _persist_entry(self, entry: AuditEntry) -> None:
   316→        """Write entry to disk (hash computed on plaintext before encryption)"""
   317→        # Daily log files
   318→        date_str = entry.timestamp_utc[:10]
   319→        log_file = self._log_dir / f"audit_{date_str}.jsonl"
   320→
   321→        line = json.dumps(entry.to_dict(), sort_keys=True)
   322→        crypto = CryptoEngine.get_instance() if ENCRYPTION_AVAILABLE else None
   323→        if crypto:
   324→            line = crypto.encrypt_line(line)
   325→
   326→        with open(log_file, 'a', encoding='utf-8') as f:
   327→            f.write(line + '\n')
   328→
   329→    def get_entries(
   330→        self,
   331→        level: Optional[AuditLevel] = None,
   332→        category: Optional[AuditCategory] = None,
   333→        operation: Optional[str] = None,
   334→        agent_id: Optional[str] = None,
   335→        sequence_id: Optional[str] = None,
   336→        since: Optional[str] = None,
   337→        limit: int = 100,
   338→    ) -> List[AuditEntry]:
   339→        """Query audit entries with filters"""
   340→        results = []
   341→
   342→        for entry in reversed(self._entries):
   343→            if level and entry.level != level:
   344→                continue
   345→            if category and entry.category != category:
   346→                continue
   347→            if operation and entry.operation != operation:
   348→                continue
   349→            if agent_id and entry.agent_id != agent_id:
   350→                continue
   351→            if sequence_id and entry.sequence_id != sequence_id:
   352→                continue
   353→            if since and entry.timestamp_utc < since:
   354→                continue
   355→
   356→            results.append(entry)
   357→            if len(results) >= limit:
   358→                break
   359→
   360→        return results
   361→
   362→    def verify_chain(self) -> Tuple[bool, Optional[int]]:
   363→        """
   364→        Verify hash chain integrity.
   365→
   366→        Returns:
   367→            (is_valid, first_invalid_index)
   368→        """
   369→        expected_hash = "genesis"
   370→
   371→        for i, entry in enumerate(self._entries):
   372→            if entry.previous_hash != expected_hash:
   373→                return False, i
   374→            expected_hash = entry.entry_hash
   375→
   376→        return True, None
   377→
   378→    def export_session(self, session_id: Optional[str] = None) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
   379→        """Export all entries for a session"""
   380→        target_session = session_id or self._current_session
   381→        return [
   382→            entry.to_dict()
   383→            for entry in self._entries
   384→            if entry.session_id == target_session
   385→        ]
   386→
   387→    def replay_info(self, operation_id: str) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
   388→        """Get info needed to replay an operation"""
   389→        for entry in self._entries:
   390→            if entry.operation_id == operation_id:
   391→                return {
   392→                    "operation": entry.operation,
   393→                    "input_data": entry.input_data,
   394→                    "before_state_hash": entry.before_state_hash,
   395→                    "expected_output": entry.output_data,
   396→                    "expected_after_hash": entry.after_state_hash,
   397→                }
   398→        return None
   399→

   402→def audit_log() -> AuditLog:
   403→    """Get global audit log instance"""
   404→    return AuditLog.get_instance()

def verify_chain(self) -> Tuple[bool, Optional[int]]:
        """
        Verify hash chain integrity.

        # Check if any audit file has been modified since last verification

            self._last_verify_result is not None
            and current_mtime <= self._last_verify_mtime
            and len(self._entries) > 0
        ):

                self._last_verify_result = result

**File:** `C:\Users\User\SYNAPSE\python\synapse\routing\router.py`

Replaced the `threading.Lock()` on `_tier_pins` with `ReadWriteLock` (imported from `synapse.memory.store`). Since pin reads happen on every routing call but writes only occur when a new tier is pinned, this reduces lock contention in high-throughput scenarios. Also added an optional `pin_key` parameter to `_pin_tier()` to avoid reconstructing the key string when the caller already has it (the linter auto-applied this to existing call sites).
